name: tolaria
title: Tolaria
description: Search notes in a Tolaria vault by file name and content, and open them in Tolaria
author: olivm

commands.name: search-notes
commands.title: Search Notes
commands.subtitle: Tolaria
commands.description: Search Tolaria vault files by name and content

preferences.name: vaultPath
preferences.title: Vault Folder
preferences.description: Tolaria folder to search. Leave empty to use the active Tolaria vault.

preferences.name: extensions
preferences.title: File Extensions
preferences.description: Comma-separated list of extensions to search (content search only applies to text files)

preferences.name: searchContent
preferences.label: Search inside file content
preferences.description: Also match the query against file content

preferences.name: fuzzySearch
preferences.label: Fuzzy file name matching
preferences.description: Match file names when the query letters appear in order (e.g. "mdf" finds "Marché_du_Film"), ignoring accents
